questions.question: Clarify the official name of the council of rectors in whose work Nuzhin participated.

localizations.source: Clarify the official name of the council of rectors in whose work Nuzhin participated.
localizations.ru: Уточнить официальное наименование совета ректоров, в работе которого участвовал Нужин.

questions.resolution: Because the sources disagree, the disputed official title was replaced by a neutral statement about coordinating the work of rectors.

questions.question: Check attribution of the personal postscript and consistency of English names and the honorary title.

localizations.source: Check attribution of the personal postscript and consistency of English names and the honorary title.
localizations.ru: Проверить атрибуцию личного послесловия и согласованность английских написаний имён и звания.

questions.resolution: The postscript remains the author’s first-person statement in Mansur Gilmullin’s article; the English version is aligned with the Russian text in meaning and names.
